posts.caption:
Ever wonder what’s in a name?

Gilding is a 5,000-year-old craft. The art of finishing something in gold — not because more is more, but because the finish is what people remember.

The edge? That’s the clean line. The sharp detail. The thing that makes you look in the mirror and actually feel it.

That’s the standard here. Every cut. Every client. Every time.

✨ Precision. Luxury. West Seattle. ✨

Meet Kara — licensed cosmetologist, esthetician, instructor and master makeup artist - the hands behind The Gilded Edge. With over a decade in the industry spanning education, speciality hair salons, and now her own boutique space in West Seattle, she brings serious craft to every appointment. Precision cuts, lived-in color, clean fades, and curly hair that actually behaves — this is what she does, and she loves it….And now — finally — her own space.

Bookings open at gildededgehair.com ✂️

posts.caption:
A high fade this clean doesn’t happen by accident ✂️

Josh keeps his fade high and tight, and that’s exactly how we run it — skin at the bottom, blended up smooth with no line to catch your eye. Length stays through the top so there’s something to sweep back and give the whole shape some lift.

This is the kind of cut that rewards regular upkeep. Crisp is a habit, not a one-time thing.

Ready for a fade that actually holds its shape? Book at gildededgehair.com

📍 5216 Delridge Way SW, Unit A · West Seattle

Summer’s in full swing. Concerts, weddings, birthdays, festivals — if you’ve got something on the calendar, let’s get you camera-ready for it.

posts.caption:
Short hair, sharp lines, zero compromise ✂️

Kevin’s asymmetrical taper fade — tight around the sides and back, enough length left up top to comb over clean. The asymmetry is what makes it: one side cut shorter than the other so the shape has direction and intention built right in.

Short doesn’t have to mean plain. It just has to be cut well.

Book at gildededgehair.com
